items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: A lot of stars, you know, at the time, Little Richard and all of the diners, all of these big stars was coming in to record.

ctx.x: Did you enjoy the recording sessions? I mean that.

Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was because they didn't have all the technique that they had. And I would take one mic, you know, and they would sit up the mic like one in the other rooms. And you had to be so hard to get picked up by so many tracks on the early years I'm speaking. Yeah, two tracks. Yeah, but we had records. Right. You know, we had plenty of money for a lot of people. Because New Orleans, before Memphis thought about getting a studio, New Orleans was just slow. They didn't take advantage of what was…
When did they start having integrated sessions?
